title: 第二十二章 所图第二十三章 死灵魔法
content_zh:
尸体在他眼前倒下。尤利尔好像被抽走了脊柱，差点没能站直。他浑身是汗，只好抽出手抹干额头。
『怎样』指环学会在使者开口之后点评了。
“战职。”使者说，“近距离比较有天赋。”什么意思？战士？
『动作是很有模有样』索伦对尤利尔说，它把话加工了一番。『而且你力气不小。要知道，许多神秘学徒都撑不到主人来。你大概能在掰手腕中赢过大多数同龄人』
“我身体健康。”但还没健康到同时和四个食尸者放对的程度。街道毫无遮蔽，因此更多尸体踉跄着跑来。
学徒精神紧绷，挥舞着剑恫吓，但亡灵们根本不在乎。而使者随手一晃，寒风夹杂雪片，食尸者顿时变成透明的粉末。虽然很有些妄想的成分，但尤利尔还是学着他挥了挥手。果然没反应。我究竟在想什么？
轰隆一声响。学徒猛然回头，发现只是瓦片坠下屋顶。这是对街的一户杂货店，如今门户大开，不幸其中只又有一个食尸者。它两条腿被砖石掩埋，无法移动。血浆涂在肚子下，散发出腐烂的气味。无需任何人指挥，他已钻过门框，一剑结果了它。
动手时，尤利尔才认出此人身上的围裙。是个年迈的园丁。我见过他吗？没有答案。尸体身首分离，非常利索，刽子手也不过如此。学徒有点想吐。我让他安息。没什么好犹豫的。这只是开始。盖亚救我！这世界真是疯了。
恶心后是眩晕。“他有家人吗？”
“谁？”
“死灵法师。”
使者皱眉。指环索伦回答：『我看不太可能。家庭美满的人没必要和死尸为伍』
“他为什么要这么做？让所有人与他感同身受？”
『多新鲜呐！散播痛苦竟也需要理由』指环嘲笑，『别指望理解疯子，尤利尔。目的和手段从来都是两回事』
“那死灵法师的目的是什么？侵略诺克斯？”
“他可没跟我说。”使者随手干掉偷袭的亡灵。“不如你亲自问。”
倘若有机会，我会问的。学徒碰了一鼻子灰。“法师比这些食尸者厉害吗？强多少？”他不指望对手还是表世界罪犯的水平。“说到底，既然他能把死人唤醒，是不是说明他也有对抗刀剑的本领？”
“不能一概而论。神秘职业赋予他死灵魔法。”
我完全懂了。“所以？还有死灵法师，这是个职业？”尤利尔的目光转向了指环先生。
『就是这样。没工资而已』但尤利尔不想听玩笑。『点燃火种是第一步。灵魂之焰沟通魔力，意味着火种和神秘之间构建了桥梁。当你转职后，职业将决定你使用魔力的方法。火种通过魔力引动神秘降临，这是第二步』

“火种是门槛，职业是门后的路？”
『不错。我原以为凡人的理解能力没达到这种水准』
难怪我没法创造冰霜。尤利尔握紧剑柄，感觉冷意源源不断钻进手心。奇异的力量在冰之剑中盘踞。他发现自己能控制一种不可见的、缺乏形体的、但又非常懒惰的东西，他挥动手臂时，能用它保护关节或增强肢体的力量，显然就是所谓魔力。熟悉运作后，他开始感受到新天地。亡灵还是亡灵，但它们慢下脚步，放轻动作，好像因他付出的代价而变得配合。
然而也没有面对使者时那么配合。或许在他眼里，学徒自以为迅速的动作，其实并没比食尸者快多少。尤利尔试了又试，发觉魔力的提升也有极限。如果想再进一步，恐怕得花上一段不短的时间。
但只是从头开始而已。我就擅长这个。“怎么获得职业？签合同？”
『转职仪式』指环告诉他，『其复杂程度远超签字，不可能随便开始。即便现在有条件，你也得承担风险』
尤利尔瞧了瞧塞西莉亚。反正情况不可能更糟，以至于他根本没有冒险的郑重感。“噢。该怎么做？”
『什么』学徒示意准备好了，但指环索伦为此大为惊诧。『你不会说现在？见鬼。别想了。神秘之路并非一蹴而就，你用魔药点燃火种就够离谱了，一般人会和塞西莉亚一样。听着，尤利尔，现在要转职根本不可能』
那我的决定有何意义？尤利尔非常失望。“也就是说，我没法对死灵法师造成威胁？”
『说实话，就算转职也不行。他能操纵全城的亡灵，我看怎么也得是死灵法师中的高手』
“高手？”
『我是说，高环』
高环。和转职有何差别？刚点燃火种呢？指环没有详细解释，尤利尔也没再追问。毕竟，说清楚也没意义，事情是明摆着的，他不可能直接和敌人站在同一起跑线，哪怕付出灵魂和他拥有的一切。学徒已有准备。然而在世界上所有的准备之中，有一大半都只能令人更深刻的体会到事实定论的绝对存在感。体面点儿说，恐怕他没把握赢。
“死灵魔法不等于能无视刀剑。”乔伊开口。
在诺克斯酒吧，埃兹·海恩斯先生告诫他们最多的话，就是不要打扰阁楼的客人。既然这项要求比欠债账单更能约束佣兵们的噪音，那显然说明违背的后果非常严重。但此刻情况不同。就算使者很不耐烦学徒的问题，他也一点儿都没表现出来。

The body fell before his eyes. Uriel seemed to have his spine taken away, and he almost couldn't stand upright. He was covered in sweat and had to take out his hand to wipe his forehead.
"How?" The Ring Society commented after the messenger spoke.
"Combat duty." The messenger said, "I am more talented at close range." What does that mean? warrior?
"The movements are very stylish," Sauron said to Uriel, and it processed the words a bit. "And you are quite strong. You know, many mysterious apprentices can't survive their master's arrival. You can probably beat most of your peers in arm wrestling.』
"I'm healthy." But not healthy enough to face four corpse-eaters at the same time. The streets were uncovered, so more bodies staggered towards them.
The apprentice was tense and waved his sword in threats, but the undead didn't care at all. The messenger waved his hand, the cold wind mixed with snow flakes, and the corpse eater suddenly turned into transparent powder. Although it was quite delusional, Uriel still imitated him and waved his hand. Sure enough, there was no response. What on earth was I thinking?
There was a boom. The apprentice turned around suddenly and found that only tiles fell from the roof. This is a grocery store across the street. Now the door is wide open. Unfortunately, there is only one more corpse eater inside. Its legs were buried in masonry and could not move. Plasma coated the underbelly, giving off a putrid smell. Without anyone's instruction, he had already slipped through the door frame and finished it off with a single blow of his sword.
When he started, Uriel recognized the apron on this person. He is an old gardener. Have I seen him? There is no answer. The corpse's body and head were separated very neatly, and the executioner was nothing more than that. The apprentice felt like vomiting. I let him rest in peace. There is nothing to hesitate about. This is just the beginning. Gaia save me! The world is crazy.
Nausea is followed by dizziness. "Does he have a family?"
"Who?"
"The Necromancer."
The messenger frowned. Sauron the Ring replied: "I think it's unlikely." There is no need for people with happy families to hang out with dead bodies.』
"Why would he do this? To make everyone feel the same way as him?"
"How fresh!" You need a reason to spread pain," the ring mocked, "Don't expect to understand a madman, Uriel. Purpose and means are always two different things.』
"Then what is the purpose of the Necromancer? To invade Knox?"
"He didn't tell me." The messenger casually killed the attacking undead. "Why don't you ask yourself."
If given the chance, I would ask. The apprentice was disappointed. "Are mages better than these corpse eaters? How much stronger?" He didn't expect his opponents to be on par with the world's criminals. "After all, since he can wake up the dead, does it mean that he also has the ability to fight swords?"
"It cannot be generalized. The mysterious profession gives him necromancy."
I totally get it. "So? There is also a Necromancer. Is this a profession?" Uriel's eyes turned to Mr. Ring.
"That's it. It’s just no salary.” But Uriel didn’t want to hear the joke. “Lighting the fire is the first step. Soul Flame communicates magic, meaning a bridge between fire and mystery. When you change classes, your class will determine how you use your magic. The fire triggers the mysterious arrival through magic power. This is the second step.』
"Fire is the threshold, and career is the road behind the door?"
"Not bad. I thought that the understanding of ordinary people did not reach this level.」
No wonder I can't create frost. Uriel tightened his grip on the hilt of the sword, feeling a steady stream of coldness creeping into his palm. Strange power is entrenched in the Ice Sword. He discovered that he could control an invisible, formless, but very lazy thing. When he waved his arms, he could use it to protect his joints or increase the strength of his limbs. This was apparently magic. After getting familiar with the operation, he began to feel the new world. The undead were still undead, but they slowed down and moved gently, as if they had become cooperative because of the price he paid.
However, he was not as cooperative as he was when facing the messenger. Perhaps in his eyes, the apprentice's movements that he thought were fast were actually not much faster than those of the corpse eaters. Uriel testAfter trying again and again, I found that there is a limit to the improvement of magic power. If you want to go further, I'm afraid it will take a while.
But just starting from scratch. I'm good at this. "How do you get a job? Sign a contract?"
The ring of the "Professor Transfer Ceremony" told him, "It is far more complicated than a signature and cannot be started casually. Even if you have the conditions now, you still have to bear the risk."
Uriel looked at Cecilia. It couldn't have been worse, so that he had no sense of seriousness about taking the risk. "Oh. What to do?"
"What?" The apprentice signaled that he was ready, but Sauron the Ring was greatly surprised. "You won't say now?" Damn it. Don't think about it. The path to mystery doesn't happen overnight, it's outrageous enough that you use magic potions to ignite the fire, and most people will be like Cecilia. Listen, Uriel, it’s impossible to change jobs now.』
So what does my decision mean? Uriel was very disappointed. "In other words, I cannot pose a threat to the Necromancer?"
"To be honest, even changing jobs won't work. He can control the undead in the city. I think he must be a master among the necromancers.』
"Master?"
"I mean, Gao Huan"
High ring. What's the difference between changing jobs? Just lit the fire? The ring was not explained in detail, and Uriel did not ask any further questions. After all, there is no point in explaining it clearly. The thing is obvious. He cannot directly stand on the same starting line with the enemy, even if he sacrifices his soul and everything he owns. The apprentice is ready. However, among all the preparations in the world, most of them can only make people more deeply realize the absolute existence of factual conclusion. To be fair, I'm afraid he has no chance of winning.
"Necromantic magic does not mean that you can ignore the sword." Joey said.
At the Knox Bar, the most Mr. Eds Haynes warned them about was not to disturb the guests in the loft. Since this requirement restrains the mercenaries' noise more than debt bills, it obviously shows that the consequences of violation are very serious. But things are different now. Even if the messenger was impatient with the apprentice's questions, he didn't show it at all.
